messages:
Sam T.: Quick sync: launch checklist for benchmark post + webinar. We need meta, JSON-LD, redirect CSV, canonical rules, and a tiny internal-link plan. Priya, can you own meta + schema?
Priya N.: Yep. I prefer JSON-LD for consistency. Will provide Article + BreadcrumbList for blog, WebPage + PotentialAction for /webinar/signup.
Luis M.: I'll do redirects and link map. Prioritizing GA top pages: /benchmarks/cost, /benchmarks/latency, /webinar/signup. Also want a note on not linking hero -> deep benchmark to avoid dilution.
seo-bot: Recommend 301 for permanent slugs; include `mainEntityOfPage` on longform; add `potentialAction` with `target` for signup CTA. Use `datePublished` on articles.
Priya N.: Draft JSON-LD snippet for /webinar/signup: {"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"WebPage","name":"Redwood Webinar","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/signup","potentialAction":{"@type":"RegisterAction","target":"https://redwood.ai/webinar/signup"}}
Sam T.: Redirect sample CSV row please: url_from,url_to,code,note
content-ops: Added: /old-bench,/benchmarks/latency,301,legacy slug; /benchmarks-old-cost,/benchmarks/cost,301,legacy
Luis M.: Canonical policy: canonicalize to clean path (strip utm/query). For syndicated copies, point canonical to primary blog.
Sam T.: Timeline: meta+schema by Tue EOD, redirects Wed AM, eng-frontend to validate snippets Wed PM. If no blockers, deploy before launch. Drop blockers here. Thanks!
